title: Morocco multiplies blueberry exports to Canada seventeenfold over three seasons - EastFruit
summary: Moroccan blueberry exporters have dramatically increased shipments to Canada, according to EastFruit. Between July 2024 and June 2025, Morocco exported 1,900 tons of blueberries to Canada, valued at over $19 million. This represents nearly double the volume from the previous season and a staggering 17-fold increase compared to three seasons...
